annotations.title: Read a saved frame render result

description: Read the saved state of an earlier soclo_image_frames request using its original clientRequestId, for example after an interruption. Free: it starts no render, cancellation or refund. Pending is not completed; only returned frame URLs and settlement fields are evidence. Frame URLs are signed and expire in minutes.

clientRequestId.description: Required before generate: one stable UUID per picture purchase. Required before frames; recover and frames_result read the original UUID without a new render. Never retry an unknown outcome automatically or mint a replacement ID to bypass a duplicate refusal.

name: soclo_image_frames_result
